_comment: SCRIPTED mock output for offline tests. These findings were written by hand; they are NOT model detections.

findings.title: Ownership check removed: broken object-level authorization
findings.description: getOwnedAccount no longer verifies that the account belongs to userId. Every caller that relies on it (GET /accounts/:id and the source account of POST /transfers) now lets any authenticated user act on any account.
findings.evidence:
if (account.ownerId !== userId) {
  throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'You do not own this account');
findings.impact: Any user can read balances of, and transfer money out of, other users' accounts.
findings.recommendation: Restore the ownerId comparison and the 403 FORBIDDEN error.

findings.title: getOwnedAccount no longer matches its documented contract
findings.description: The doc comment says the account is returned only if it belongs to userId, but the ownership branch was deleted.
findings.impact: Callers relying on the documented behaviour are silently broken.
findings.recommendation: Restore the check or rename the function and update every caller.
